seriesTitle: My Status as an Assassin Obviously Exceeds the Hero's

episodes.title: The Assassin Eats Bread
episodes.summary: Transported with his class to another world, Akira quickly discovers that he far surpasses his classmates.

episodes.title: The Assassin Takes Care of the Wounded
episodes.summary: Akira is fighting his way through the Kantinen Labyrinth when he encounters an injured elf.

episodes.title: The Assassin Bonds with a Cat
episodes.summary: Akira finds a black cat, sent by the Demon Lord, in the labyrinth. He decides to make it his servant.

episodes.title: The Assassin Calls the Name
episodes.summary: The gang encounters Kilika, Amelia's sister, who holds a massive grudge against her.

episodes.title: The Assassin Sleeps in a Bed
episodes.summary: Akira and gang head to the land of beastfolk and face new encounters.

episodes.title: The Assassin Fights a Demon
episodes.summary: Amelia has been abducted, and Akira gets some unexpected aid in his quest to take her back.

episodes.title: The Assassin Makes a Vow
episodes.summary: Akira faces an unprecedented challenge as Mahiro, another demon, appears to take him on.

episodes.title: The Assassin Is Spellbound
episodes.summary: His determination renewed, Akira now gets to... watch a beauty pageant?

episodes.title: The Assassin Sees The Sights
episodes.summary: Akira separates from the hero's party to search for clues about Gram while wandering through a new city.

episodes.title: The Assassin Gazes at the River Surface
episodes.summary: Crow tells Akira things about Gram to convince him to kill him, but he remembers his family and hesitates.

episodes.title: The Assassin Browses
episodes.summary: Akira and the others investigate the Uruk City Adventurer's Guild to obtain information about Gram.

episodes.title: Oda Akira Becomes an Assassin
episodes.summary: After much deliberation and an unpleasant encounter with Gram at the guild, Akira decides what to do.
